tools.name: search_knowledge_base
tools.description: Search Vitextra knowledge base, documentation, product pages, how-to guides, FAQ, glossary and blog. Returns titles, page URLs, Markdown URLs and short descriptions; read a page in full with get_document.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Read a Vitextra page as Markdown: knowledge base article, how-to guide, blog post, product page (with pricing, features, platforms, FAQ), the FAQ or the glossary. Pass a url from search_knowledge_base or list_products.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List all Vitextra products with their page URLs, Markdown URLs and one-line descriptions.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: NLWeb-compatible question answering over the site content: returns the most relevant pages as schema.org objects in the NLWeb result format (url, name, site, score, description, schema_object).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_knowledge_base, get_document, list_products · Private data: get_document · Public sink: get_document · Destructive: ask.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_knowledge_base, get_document, list_products · Private data: get_document · Public sink: get_document · Destructive: ask

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
